carbon_source.interpretation: WAM sector-emissions envelope as a scenario assumption for the covered direct power/heating emissions; not a Croatian statutory cap

market.method: 12 monthly x 24 hourly observed price means; expanded to the common 8760-hour non-leap model calendar
market.choice: Preserve the existing model price level and cost basis; change only the observed seasonal/diurnal shape. This is a fixed external-market scenario, not a wholesale-price forecast.
market.shape_interpretation: Averaging removes individual-day price spikes; all derived monthly-hourly means happen to be positive. No price clipping or battery-arbitrage control is introduced.

future_storage_duration_interpretation: Declared future technology assumption. Existing installations unchanged; grid-MW growth, imports, gas ban and emissions caps unchanged.
existing_gas_rule: Retain existing 2025 individual/district gas-boiler stock through 2050; no new gas capacity.
industry_rule: Prescribed demand/fuel inputs; industrial technology replacement is not optimized.
hourly_exchange: Effective net-import capacity 2000 MW in 2025, 3450-3600 MW thereafter; no annual quota. Per-window audits and actual peaks are included in the extract.
